hyperfine constants of 4f, 6f, 7f: not in Allegrini et al. 2022 Table VII; for 5f only upper limits |A(5F5/2)| < 0.7 MHz and |A(5F7/2)| < 1.0 MHz (Svanberg, Tsekeris, Happer 1973) are listed there
hyperfine A of 11p 2P1/2: no measurement in Allegrini et al. 2022 Table VII

directly measured 6p-5d matrix elements: none found in the sources opened; all-order theory values entered (portal 5d3/2-6p1/2 = 7.06(14); Safronova et al. 2016 Table I prints 7.1(1), 3.19(7), 9.7(2))

Rafac et al. 1994/1999, Young et al. 1994, DiBerardino et al. 1998, Marek / Marek & Niemax / Marek & Ryschka, Neil & Atkinson 1984, Ortiz & Campos 1981 were not opened themselves; their numbers are taken as quoted in Safronova et al. 2016, the UDel portal or Steck
isotope shifts: 133Cs is the only stable isotope, none entered
notes: rme_J_ea0 is the absolute value of the reduced electric-dipole matrix element <n l J||D||n' l' J'> in units of e*a0, in the convention of the Safronova papers and the UDel portal (the same as ARC getReducedMatrixElementJ): symmetric in the two levels. Steck's D-line sheet uses <J||er||J'> smaller by sqrt(2J+1) of the lower level (factor sqrt(2) for the D lines); Steck values are given under rme_J_ea0.alternatives. Entries with method "theory" are relativistic all-order values from the Safronova group, taken from the UDel portal data service (https://atom.ece.udel.edu/graphql behind https://www1.udel.edu/atom/) or from Phys. Rev. A 94, 012505 (2016). A_s and branching were computed by the portal from those matrix elements and NIST energies. Each level has one "lifetime" (experiment preferred) and "lifetime_alternatives". For n >= 8 the old measurements (Marek & Niemax 1976, Neil & Atkinson 1984, Sieradzan 1979) are 5-20% shorter than the all-order theory; the 2016 paper considers their uncertainties underestimated, so the theory alternative may be the better number for a 0 K radiative lifetime. For 5d3/2 the 1998 measurement 909(15) ns disagrees with theory 966(34) ns; for 5d5/2 the 2020 measurement 1353(5) ns confirmed theory against the 1998 value 1281(9) ns. Hyperfine constants are from the recommended / weighted-average rows of Allegrini et al. 2022. ionization_energy is an extra top-level block.
